name: Laos (Kingdom, 1952–1975)
description: A red field charged with a white three-headed elephant on a pedestal beneath a parasol.
history: Flag of the Kingdom of Laos until the Pathet Lao abolished the monarchy in December 1975.

features.role: three-headed elephant (Erawan) on pedestal beneath a nine-tiered parasol
features.symbolism: the three-headed elephant of Lan Xang, 'the land of a million elephants'; the parasol the monarchy
